description: DOI integrity check — Check up to 20 DOIs (dois= separated by commas or spaces; doi.org links and doi: prefixes accepted) for retractions, withdrawals, expressions of concern and corrections using Crossref metadata, which includes the Retraction Watch database. Each result gives status RETRACTED / WITHDRAWN / EXPRESSION OF CONCERN / CORRECTED / OK / NOTICE / NOT FOUND / INVALID, title, journal, publisher, date, citation count, license, notice DOIs with dates, preprint relations and citing advice. Use it to vet references, AI-generated citations and literature reviews. Example: /v1/research/doi-check?dois=10.1016/S0140-6736(97)11096-0,10.1038/nature12373 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: research_doi_check
